newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning, fuelled by NY.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning, fuelled by NY.

text.p: Tokyo stocks leaped in the early Thursday morning session as investors flocked to blue-chip issues, inspired by the Dow's close overnight above the 8,000 mark for the first time, brokers said.
They said, however, that blue chips alone were not strong enough to push the Nikkei average far above the 20,500 level, and that buying of domestic issues needed to pick up.
As of 0018 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 181.11 points or 0.89 percent at 20,539.85. Its September futures added 190 points to reach 20,620.
